decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page in both years and builds on the firm's market-data base, so carrying it costs little while its value is still unfolding, which makes the option worth holding.

Its fall from its own page to a mere mention, while sibling tariff tools B, D and F disappeared, points to weakening value; but it sits close to the core tariff-calculation business and costs little to maintain, so keeping it for now is cheaper than resolving the option early.

The area definition tool was also reduced to a mention, yet it likely serves as a low-cost component supporting other location-based offerings on the central platform, so the remaining uncertainty still justifies holding it.
